# Technical Documentation: Sales Target Management Feature

## 1\. Overview

This document outlines the technical requirements and implementation strategy for the "Sales Targets" feature, enabling administrators to set and monitor sales performance targets for sales personnel based on invoice revenue.

## 2\. Business Requirements

1. Admin can set monthly targets for sales personnel  
2. Yearly target \= Monthly target × 12  
3. Company yearly target \= Sum of all sales personnel's yearly targets  
4. Target achievement calculated from invoice revenue  
5. Monthly and yearly revenue tracking  
6. Carry-forward of unmet targets to subsequent months

## 4\. Backend Implementation

### 4.1 Database Models

| // models/Target.jsclass Target extends Model {  static init(sequelize) {    return super.init({      user\_id: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      year: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      month: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      target\_amount: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(15, 2), allowNull: false },      carried\_over\_amount: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(15, 2), defaultValue: 0 },      adjusted\_target\_amount: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(15, 2), allowNull: false }    }, { sequelize, modelName: 'sales\_targets' });  }}// models/TargetAchievement.jsclass TargetAchievement extends Model {  static init(sequelize) {    return super.init({      user\_id: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      year: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      month: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },      achieved\_amount: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(15, 2), defaultValue: 0 },      target\_amount: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(15, 2), allowNull: false },      achievement\_percentage: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(5, 2), defaultValue: 0 }    }, { sequelize, modelName: 'target\_achievements' });  }} |

### 4.3 Core Services

| // services/TargetService.jsclass TargetService {  async calculateMonthlyAchievement(userId, year, month) {    const revenue \= await Invoice.sum('total', {      where: {        sales\_person\_id: userId,        status: 'paid',        \[Op.and\]: \[          Sequelize.where(Sequelize.fn('YEAR', Sequelize.col('issue\_date')), year),          Sequelize.where(Sequelize.fn('MONTH', Sequelize.col('issue\_date')), month)        \]      }    });    return revenue || 0;  }  async calculateCarryOverTarget(userId, year, month) {    const previousMonth \= month \=== 1 ? { year: year \- 1, month: 12 } : { year, month: month \- 1 };        const previousAchievement \= await TargetAchievement.findOne({      where: { user\_id: userId, ...previousMonth }    });    if (\!previousAchievement) return 0;    const unmetTarget \= Math.max(0, previousAchievement.target\_amount \- previousAchievement.achieved\_amount);    return unmetTarget;  }  async recalculateTargets(userId, year, month) {    const carriedOver \= await this.calculateCarryOverTarget(userId, year, month);    const currentTarget \= await SalesTarget.findOne({ where: { user\_id: userId, year, month } });        const adjustedTarget \= (currentTarget?.target\_amount || 0) \+ carriedOver;        await SalesTarget.upsert({      user\_id: userId,      year,      month,      target\_amount: currentTarget?.target\_amount || 0,      carried\_over\_amount: carriedOver,      adjusted\_target\_amount: adjustedTarget    });    return adjustedTarget;  }} |
| :---- |

### 4.4 Scheduled Tasks

| // jobs/CalculateTargetAchievements.jscron.schedule('0 2 1 \* \*', async () \=\> { // Run at 2:00 AM on 1st of every month  const previousMonth \= new Date();  previousMonth.setMonth(previousMonth.getMonth() \- 1);    const year \= previousMonth.getFullYear();  const month \= previousMonth.getMonth() \+ 1;  const salesUsers \= await User.findAll({    include: \[{      model: UserRole,      where: { role: 'sales' }    }\]  });  for (const user of salesUsers) {    const targetService \= new TargetService();    await targetService.recalculateTargets(user.id, year, month);  }}); |
| :---- |

### 5.3 State Management (Pinia)

| // stores/targets.jsimport { defineStore } from 'pinia';export const useTargetStore \= defineStore('targets', {  state: () \=\> ({    targets: \[\],    achievements: \[\],    overview: null,    loading: false  }),  actions: {    async fetchTargetsOverview() {      this.loading \= true;      try {        const response \= await api.get('/admin/targets/overview');        this.overview \= response.data;      } catch (error) {        console.error('Error fetching targets overview:', error);      } finally {        this.loading \= false;      }    },    async setTarget(targetData) {      try {        await api.post('/admin/targets', targetData);        await this.fetchTargetsOverview();      } catch (error) {        console.error('Error setting target:', error);        throw error;      }    }  },  getters: {    totalYearlyTarget: (state) \=\> {      return state.overview?.yearly\_target || 0;    },    currentMonthAchievement: (state) \=\> {      return state.overview?.current\_month\_achievement || 0;    },    achievementPercentage: (state) \=\> {      const target \= state.overview?.current\_month\_target || 1;      const achievement \= state.currentMonthAchievement;      return Math.min(100, (achievement / target) \* 100);    }  }}); |
| :---- |

## 6\. Security Considerations

1. **Role-based access control**: Only admin users can set targets  
2. **Data isolation**: Sales users can only view their own performance  
3. **Input validation**: Validate target amounts and dates  
4. **Audit logging**: Log all target changes and calculations

## 7\. Performance Optimizations

1. **Database indexing**:  
   

| CREATE INDEX idx\_invoices\_sales\_date ON invoices(sales\_person\_id, issue\_date, status);CREATE INDEX idx\_targets\_user\_year\_month ON sales\_targets(user\_id, year, month); |
| :---- |

   

2. **Query optimization**: Use efficient aggregate queries for revenue calculations  
     
3. **Caching**: Cache monthly achievement calculations for 24 hours  
     
4. **Batch processing**: Process target recalculations in batches during off-peak hours

### 8.2 Frontend Tests

This implementation provides a comprehensive sales target management system with carry-forward functionality, performance tracking, and administrative controls.
